name: MT-BENCHMARK-IL-ILGOV
description:
📘 IL-ILGOV-2024: Indian Language Translation Benchmark
	

IL-ILGOV-2024 is a multilingual translation benchmark corpus for Indian languages developed under the HIndustani Machini ANuvaad TechnoloGY (HIMANGY) / MTIL project, with Hindi as source language and 12 target languages in the governance domain. (ResearchGate)
This dataset is aimed at evaluating and benchmarking machine translation (MT) systems across Indian languages in a domain that reflects real-world governance text.… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/HimangY/MT-BENCHMARK-IL-ILGOV.
evaluation_method: BLEU / chrF (automatic MT metrics); human judgment may be used for quality in-domain
typical_sota_score: 10–40 BLEU (varies substantially by language pair and direction)
reputation: Targeted benchmark developed under HIMANGY for Indian-language MT; of growing relevance to researchers working on Indian languages and domain-specific translation.
